info.name: Discover all favicons from a URL

params.name: url
params.description: Target URL to analyze (must include http:// or https://).

items.docs:
Parses a page's `<link>` tags and returns every favicon/icon found
(apple-touch-icon, icon, shortcut icon, etc.) as structured JSON,
with document order preserved. Includes a best-guess recommendation
and a /favicon.ico fallback flag when no link-rel icons exist.

params.name: url
params.description: Target URL to analyze (must include http:// or https://).

items.docs: Returns the raw favicon image bytes for a URL (proxied to avoid CORS issues in browser clients).
